parameters.name: prompt
parameters.value:
=Analyze this note and provide:
1. 3-5 relevant tags (comma-separated)
2. One-sentence summary
3. Key entities (people, places, projects)
4. Suggested connections to topics

Note: {{ $json.original_content }}

Format your response as JSON:
{
  "tags": ["tag1", "tag2"],
  "summary": "Brief summary",
  "entities": ["entity1", "entity2"],
  "connections": ["topic1", "topic2"]
}

nodes.name: Save Enriched Note to Blinko
nodes.notes: Creates a new note with AI analysis. Replace YOUR_BLINKO_TOKEN with actual token from Blinko settings.
